Subject: [UAI] research faculty position at the ANU

The Australian National University is advertising a 5 years 
research-intensive academic position in computer science: 
http://info.anu.edu.au/hr/Jobs/Academic_Positions/_CECS3964.asp

This position is only open to women applicants and the deadline for 
applications is August 24.

The strengths of the lab are in artificial intelligence (including 
diagnosis, machine learning, planning & scheduling), and in logic & 
automated reasoning (tableaux, theorem proving, SAT/constraints), but we 
would most welcome applicants in other areas  synergetic to those.

Sylvie Thiebaux
-- 
Associate Professor
Computer Sciences Laboratory
The Australian National University
Canberra ACT 0200, Australia
http://rsise.anu.edu.au/~thiebaux
